d: Long, flowing crimson hair with voluminous waves and jagged bangs frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, piercing crimson eyes. A slender build is dressed in a white crop top and matching white loincloth-style skirt, layered with a translucent white wrap and a flowing teal cloak featuring gold trim. Gold jewelry adorns the neck, wrists, ankles, and hair, while a large gold bow is held in one hand.
